types.name: Cancelled
docs: Emitted after a seller cancels their own listing and the leaf_delegate is
restored back to the seller.

types.name: CollectionState
docs: One-time PDA at seeds `[b"collection_state"]`. Binds the deployed program
to a specific Metaplex Token Metadata collection NFT so `settle_prediction`
and `claim_match_card` can mint sticker + match cNFTs *into* that collection
via Bubblegum's `MintToCollectionV1`.
This is Option B from `notes/collection-upgrade-plan.md` — additive PDA
rather than a `TreeState` schema change, so the upgrade is safe even though
`TreeState` is already initialized on devnet.

docs: Metaplex NFT owned by `mint_auth`. See `scripts/create-collection.ts`.

docs: Cached canonical bump so downstream ixs don't re-derive.

fields.name: admin

types.name: CollectionStateInitialized

Frontends can subscribe once to learn the on-chain collection mint that
all future sticker + match-card cNFTs will be verified into.

types.name: Group
docs: User-created social group. `group_id` is stored as the first field so
clients can `getProgramAccounts({filters: [memcmp(offset=8, group_id)]})`
to enumerate a specific group by id (P-06).

fields.name: bump
docs: Cached canonical PDA bump (P-04) — saves ~1.5K CU per reader ix.

types.name: GroupCreated
docs: Emitted after a new social group PDA is created.

types.name: GroupExtension
docs: Pass-10 additive PDA. Sidecar account attached to a `Group` for the new
admin/creator functionality (pause + prize distribution) without altering
the on-chain layout of the already-deployed `Group` account (which would
break every existing devnet group by breaking Borsh deserialize length).
Seeds: `[b"group_ext", group.key().as_ref()]`.
Created lazily on first `pause_group` / `unpause_group` / `distribute_prize`
call via `init_if_needed`. Legacy groups (created before Pass 10) simply
don't have an extension yet and behave exactly as they did before —
non-breaking upgrade.

fields.name: group
docs: Back-pointer to the parent Group PDA (defense-in-depth vs seed spoofing).

fields.name: paused
docs: Admin kill-switch. When true, `join_group` and `distribute_prize` reject.

fields.name: prize_distributed
docs: Payout replay guard. When true, `distribute_prize` rejects.

fields.name: bump
docs: Cached canonical PDA bump.

types.name: GroupPaused
docs: Emitted after `pause_group` flips `GroupExtension.paused = true`.

types.name: GroupUnpaused

types.name: Listed
docs: Emitted after a sticker cNFT is listed for sale.

types.name: Listing
docs: Marketplace listing for a compressed sticker NFT.
`active` bool guards CEI ordering in `buy_card` / `cancel_listing`.
`bump` is the canonical PDA bump captured at init time so that later
instructions can re-derive the Listing PDA from the `asset_id` ix arg
(not from the potentially-attacker-supplied `listing.asset_id` field —
see code-review F-02).

types.name: MatchCardClaimed
docs: Emitted after a fixture's summary "match card" cNFT is minted.
See [`StickerMinted`] for the meaning of `event_stat_root`, `proof_ts`,
`asset_id`, `merkle_tree`.

types.name: MemberJoined
docs: Emitted after a user joins a group (post current_size increment).

types.name: Membership
docs: Per-user group membership. Score tracks running hit count.

fields.name: bump
docs: Cached canonical PDA bump (P-04).

types.name: PredictionCard
docs: User's prediction slate for a single fixture. Fixed 8-slot array
with `slot_count` denoting the actual used length.
`match_card_event_stat_root` + `match_card_proof_ts` are populated by
`claim_match_card` from the successful TxLINE proof so every claim
deep-links back to a specific Merkle root + timestamp (proof lineage).

fields.name: bump
docs: Cached canonical PDA bump (P-04).

types.name: PredictionSlot
docs: A single stat prediction. Copy-friendly (fits in the fixed
`[PredictionSlot; 8]` array on PredictionCard).
Field semantics:
- `stat_a_key` : ScoreStat.key for primary stat (must be > 0 to be valid)
- `stat_b_key` : 0 = compound not used; otherwise ScoreStat.key of second term
- `op`         : 0 = None, 1 = Add, 2 = Subtract (BinaryExpression mirror)
- `predicate_comparison` : 0 = GreaterThan, 1 = LessThan, 2 = EqualTo
(mirrors TxLINE `Comparison` enum ordinals)
- `threshold`  : Momentum-side threshold BEFORE any keeper negation
- `period`     : match period (e.g. 0 = full-time, 1 = 1st half, 2 = 2nd half)
- `status`     : SlotStatus discriminant (0 Pending, 1 Hit, 2 Miss)
- `sticker_asset_seq` : 0 until minted; then = TreeState.next_index at mint time
- `event_stat_root`   : `[0u8; 32]` until settled; then the `event_stat_root`
bytes captured from the TxLINE `StatTerm` (proof lineage)
- `proof_ts`          : 0 until settled; then the `ts` arg passed to TxLINE

types.name: PredictionSlotInput
docs: Client-side input shape. Mirrored to `PredictionSlot` server-side with
`status = Pending` and `sticker_asset_seq = 0`.

types.name: PredictionsSubmitted
docs: Emitted after a user's prediction card is committed on-chain.

types.name: PrizeDistributed
docs: Emitted after a group's SOL vault has been proportionally distributed to
its members based on their `Membership.score`. Closes the F-19
trapped-SOL gap for fee-charging groups.

types.name: ScoreStat
docs: The on-chain representation of a single, provable key-value statistic.
This is the leaf of the inner-most Merkle tree.

types.name: ScoresBatchSummary
docs: The summary for a single fixture's scores events within a 5-minute batch.
This contains the root of the sub-tree of all events for that fixture.

types.name: Sold
docs: Emitted after a sticker cNFT is purchased and the Listing PDA is closed.

types.name: StickerMinted
docs: Emitted after a slot is settled and its outcome sticker cNFT is minted.
`outcome` mirrors `SlotStatus`: 1 = Hit, 2 = Miss.
`sticker_asset_seq` is the `TreeState.next_index` value captured at mint
time. Downstream indexers can pair this with the tree pubkey to derive the
Bubblegum asset id via `get_asset_id(tree, nonce)`.
Proof lineage fields (`event_stat_root`, `proof_ts`) let a frontend deep-link
each minted sticker to the exact TxLINE Merkle root and 5-minute slot that
proved it — the sponsor's "tamper-evident timestamp" story made visible.
`asset_id` and `merkle_tree` are included so any indexer can navigate from
a `StickerMinted` log directly to the DAS record without needing to know
how Bubblegum derives asset ids.

types.name: TreeInitialized
docs: Emitted once (per program deploy) at `initialize_tree_state`. Lets any
frontend or indexer display "MOMENTUM vN" and bind the deployed program
to its Bubblegum tree + mint authority PDA without a second RPC roundtrip.

types.name: TreeState
docs: One-time bootstrap PDA. Binds Momentum to a specific Bubblegum tree
and caches the mint-authority PDA bump.
